identity.title: Powered Industrial Truck Operator Training and Evaluation Record

scan.summary: This is the company's training and evaluation record for operators of powered industrial trucks (forklifts and pallet jacks) at the Portland facility, maintained as required by OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178(l) and Oregon OSHA. It documents formal instruction, practical training, evaluations, and trainer qualifications for three operators across two truck types.
scan.freshness_note: Record was last updated June 2, 2025. As of today (September 29, 2026), the record is 15 months old and needs immediate updating: R. Patel's next evaluation was due May 19, 2026 and is now overdue.

gaps.title: Record is stale and evaluation overdue for R. Patel
gaps.description: The record's last update was June 2, 2025. R. Patel (Rina Patel) has an evaluation due date of May 19, 2026, which passed 132 days ago. The current date is September 29, 2026, and no updated evaluation is shown. OSHA requires an evaluation at least once every three years; this operator's has expired.
gaps.fix: Conduct R. Patel's overdue evaluation immediately and update the record. Document the evaluation date and next evaluation due date (three years from the evaluation).
gaps.locator: Table row for R. Patel; record footer
